items.title: License
items.text:

  • Software & Documentation (firmware/, docs/, & scripts): Licensed under the MIT License.

items.title: 1. Hardware Block Diagram
items.text:
The board is divided into an AC Mains Primary Zone (230V AC) and a Reinforced-Isolated Secondary Zone (5V / 3.3V DC) separated by a >= 5.0 mm creepage barrier and a 1.5 mm milled PCB slot.

flowchart LR
    subgraph Primary ["230V AC Primary Zone (High Voltage)"]
        AC["230V AC Input<br/>5.08mm Screw Terminal"] --> FUSE["1A Slow-Blow Fuse<br/>+ 10D471K MOV"]
        FUSE --> EMI["Conducted EMI Filter<br/>0.1uF X2 Cap + 10mH CM Choke"]
    end

    EMI ==>|"Reinforced Isolation<br/>(>= 5.0mm Gap + 1.5mm Slot)"| HLK["Hi-Link HLK-5M05 / PM01<br/>230V AC to 5V DC"]

    subgraph Secondary ["Low-Voltage Secondary Zone (3.3V / 5V Safe)"]
        HLK -->|"5V Rail"| LDO["AP2112K-3.3 LDO<br/>(5V to 3.3V)"]
        HLK -->|"5V Power"| LS["74AHCT1G125<br/>5V Level Shifter"]

        LDO -->|"3.3V Rail"| MCU["ESP32-C3-MINI-1<br/>Wi-Fi Microcontroller"]

        MODE["J_MODE Jumper<br/>(Stair vs Desk)"] -->|"GPIO4"| MCU
        MCU <-->|"I2C (GPIO8/9)"| SENS["J_I2C (Qwiic)<br/>BH1750 Lux + SHT40 Temp"]
        PIR["J_PIR (3-Pin JST)<br/>AM312 / mmWave Motion"] -->|"GPIO5 + RC Filter"| MCU
        BTN["J_BTN (2-Pin JST)<br/>Study Desk Button"] -->|"GPIO6 + RC Filter"| MCU
        MCU -->|"GPIO7"| BZR["Piezo Buzzer<br/>(NPN Driver)"]
        MCU -->|"GPIO10 (3.3V)"| LS
        LS -->|"5V Data + 330R"| LED["J_LED (3-Pin JST)<br/>WS2812B LED Strip"]
    end

    style Primary fill:#ffe6e6,stroke:#cc0000,stroke-width:2px
    style Secondary fill:#e6f3ff,stroke:#0066cc,stroke-width:2px

items.title: 3. Dual-Mode Operating States
items.text:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Boot: Power On (230V AC)
    Boot --> CheckMode: Read Mode Jumper / Flash Config

    CheckMode --> BunkStairMode: Mode = STAIR
    CheckMode --> StudyDeskMode: Mode = DESK

    state BunkStairMode {
        [*] --> IdleDark
        IdleDark --> FadeOn: PIR / mmWave Triggered
        FadeOn --> HoldLight: Soft Warm-White Step Glow
        HoldLight --> FadeOff: No Motion for 30s
        FadeOff --> IdleDark
    }

    state StudyDeskMode {
        [*] --> AmbientStandby
        AmbientStandby --> TaskLighting: Button Press / Home Assistant
        TaskLighting --> BreakReminder: 45-Min Study Timer Chime
        BreakReminder --> TaskLighting: Button Acknowledge
    }

items.title: 4. Microcontroller Pin Allocation Table (ESP32-C3-MINI-1)
items.text:
Locking in pin assignments before schematic capture prevents strapping-pin boot conflicts:

ESP32-C3 Pin Net Name Sheet Direction Function & Notes GPIO4 MODE_SEL sheet_mcu_core Input (Pull-up) Closed to GND = Stair Mode; Open = Desk Mode GPIO5 PIR_IN sheet_sensors Input Motion sensor trigger (1k + 100nF low-pass filter) GPIO6 BTN_IN sheet_sensors Input (Pull-up) Desk tactile switch (10k + 100nF debounce) GPIO7 BUZZER_PWM sheet_outputs Output PWM tone output to MMBT2222A buzzer driver GPIO8 I2C_SDA sheet_sensors Bidir I2C Data (4.7k pull-up to +3V3) GPIO9 I2C_SCL sheet_sensors Output I2C Clock (4.7k pull-up to +3V3, also Boot strapping pin) GPIO10 LED_DATA_3V3 sheet_outputs Output Feeds 74AHCT1G125 buffer -> 5V WS2812B data EN / GPIO9 RESET / BOOT sheet_mcu_core Input On-board tactile buttons + 4-pin UART header for flashing

items.title: System Requirements Specification: Bunk & Desk Node
1. Use Cases & Functional Requirements (REQ-FUNC)
items.text: ID Use Case / Requirement Acceptance Criteria Verification Method Linked Artifact REQ-FUNC-01 Unified Dual-Mode Hardware: One common PCB supports both bunk-bed stair lighting and study desk automation. Hardware mode selection via 2-pin jumper (J_MODE closed = Stair, open = Desk). Bench test in both modes hardware/sheet_mcu_core.kicad_sch REQ-FUNC-02 Night-Time Stair Guidance: Smoothly illuminate bunk stairs when a child approaches at night. Drive 5V WS2812B LED strip via 3.3V-to-5V logic level shifter; fade on/off over 1.5s. Oscilloscope & LED strip test hardware/sheet_outputs.kicad_sch REQ-FUNC-03 Automatic Motion Trigger: Detect movement near bunk stairs without false triggers. Support 3.3V PIR/mmWave sensor (J_PIR) with hardware RC noise filter. Motion trigger latency test hardware/sheet_sensors.kicad_sch REQ-FUNC-04 Study Desk Light & Break Chime: Provide desk task lighting, ambient monitoring, and 45-min study break alerts. Support external push button (J_BTN), piezo buzzer, and I2C sensors (J_I2C). Functional button, buzzer & I2C scan hardware/sheet_sensors.kicad_sch REQ-FUNC-05 Home Assistant & Bedtime Cue: Allow wireless control and scheduled evening amber wind-down lighting. 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi connectivity via ESP32 module with OTA firmware updates. Home Assistant integration test firmware/

items.title: 2. Electrical Safety Requirements (REQ-SAFE)
items.text: ID Requirement Acceptance Criteria Verification Method Linked Artifact REQ-SAFE-01 Direct Mains Operation: Operate directly from 230V AC 50Hz bedroom wiring without external wall adapters. Integrated isolated AC-DC module (HLK-PM01 / HLK-5M05) outputting 5V DC + 3.3V LDO. Load regulation & thermal check hardware/sheet_power_hv.kicad_sch REQ-SAFE-02 Primary Overcurrent & Surge Protection: Protect against short circuits and Indian grid voltage spikes. 1A/250V slow-blow PCB fuse (F1) + 10D471K MOV (RV1) on AC input. Schematic ERC & BOM inspection hardware/sheet_power_hv.kicad_sch REQ-SAFE-03 Reinforced Primary-to-Secondary Isolation: Prevent electric shock hazard between 230V AC and low-voltage touch circuits. Minimum >= 5.0 mm creepage/clearance gap + 1.5 mm milled isolation slot (Edge.Cuts). KiCad DRC (Mains_HV custom rule) hardware/bunk-and-desk-node.kicad_pcb REQ-SAFE-04 Child-Safe Enclosure: Prevent accidental finger contact with live mains terminals. Fully enclosed 3D-printed housing secured with M3 screws and cable strain relief. Mechanical fit & STEP inspection enclosure/bunk-and-desk-node.step

items.title: 3. EMC & EMI Requirements (REQ-EMC)
items.text: ID Requirement Acceptance Criteria Verification Method Linked Artifact REQ-EMC-01 Conducted EMI Suppression: Prevent switching supply noise from radiating onto house AC wiring. 0.1 uF X2 safety capacitor + 10 mH common-mode choke before AC-DC module. Schematic & layout review hardware/sheet_power_hv.kicad_sch REQ-EMC-02 Low-Impedance Ground Return: Minimize radiated emissions on the low-voltage digital section. Unbroken B.Cu ground plane (GND) under secondary side with perimeter stitching vias. PCB layout inspection hardware/bunk-and-desk-node.kicad_pcb REQ-EMC-03 Local Power Decoupling & Data Damping: Prevent high-frequency ringing on MCU and LED lines. 100 nF + 10 uF ceramic caps within 3 mm of VDD pins; 330 ohm series resistor on LED data. PCB layout & waveform check hardware/sheet_mcu_core.kicad_sch

items.title: 2. Power & Electrical Safety Requirements (REQ-SAFE)
items.text: ID Requirement Description Target / Parameter Verification Method KiCad / DRC Link REQ-SAFE-01 Direct universal AC mains input converted on-board to isolated low-voltage DC. 230V AC 50Hz input to isolated 5V/3.3V output Load regulation & thermal check hardware/sheet_power.kicad_sch REQ-SAFE-02 Over-current and transient surge protection on the AC mains entry. 1A slow-blow PCB fuse + 10D471K MOV Visual BOM & schematic ERC hardware/sheet_power.kicad_sch REQ-SAFE-03 Reinforced creepage and clearance between 230V AC primary and 3.3V/5V secondary circuits. >= 5.0 mm clearance + 1.5 mm milled isolation slot KiCad DRC (Mains_HV custom rule) hardware/step-and-study-hub.kicad_dru REQ-SAFE-04 Fully enclosed touch-safe housing suitable for a children's bedroom. 3D-printed enclosure with strain-relief cable exits Mechanical fit & STEP inspection enclosure/case_v1.step

items.title: 3. EMC & EMI Requirements (REQ-EMC)
items.text: ID Requirement Description Target / Parameter Verification Method KiCad / PCB Link REQ-EMC-01 Conducted EMI suppression at the 230V AC mains input stage. X2 safety capacitor + common-mode choke before AC-DC module Schematic review & line noise check hardware/sheet_power.kicad_sch REQ-EMC-02 Uninterrupted low-impedance ground return path on the low-voltage section. Solid B.Cu ground pour with edge stitching vias PCB layout inspection hardware/step-and-study-hub.kicad_pcb REQ-EMC-03 Local power-supply decoupling on all active ICs and wireless modules. 100 nF + 10 uF ceramic capacitors within 3 mm of VDD pins PCB layout inspection hardware/step-and-study-hub.kicad_pcb
